tools.name: search
tools.description: Looks up Paddle API methods by name or description. Returns the method path, parameters, and response shape so the agent knows how to call it.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Runs a JavaScript async function that chains one or more Paddle API calls in a single invocation. Variables don't persist between calls.

tools.name: report_missing_tool
tools.description: Lets the agent flag a missing capability so we can prioritize it. This doesn't call the Paddle API, it reports the missing tool to the Paddle team.
